correctness.rationale: A qubit difference (rho(r)-rho(s)) has eigenvalues +/-|r-s|/2, so all Schatten p distances differ from Euclidean Bloch distance only by a common factor. Characters on (Z/m)^n diagonalize both squared energies: L multiplier 4 s(k) with s the number of odd coordinates; R multiplier 2(1-product_j q(k_j)), q(h)=(1+2cos(2pi h/m))/3. Because |q(h)|<=a for odd h and |q(h)|<=1 otherwise, 2s/(1-a^s) is bounded by 2n/(1-a^n), and is strict except the +/-1 all-odd band. A real pure Bloch Fourier plane realizes equality and preserves the ball. For four displayed diagonal qutrit states, verify all PSD unit-trace entries; direct exact arithmetic yields long energy 20/9 and ternary short energy 4/9, quotient 5, compared with qubit 9/2. Independent rational witness calculation and nine independent Fourier-mode checks passed. Crucially the qutrit inequality is a lower bound only, not an exact d>=3 constant.
